_comment: bits store-token signer: the fourth security-proxy instance. Its routes sign the store tokens the backend issues, each with its own Ed25519 key pushed by `make unlock`: people's (bits login, the console; slot 'bits-store-token-key' from secrets/bits-store-token-key.enc.pem, make store-token-key) and build jobs' (POST /ops/ci/store-token; slot 'bits-store-build-token-key' from secrets/bits-store-build-token-key.enc.pem, make store-build-token-key); and the builds bits-store keeps in /restricted, signed when stored (slot 'bits-restricted-sign-key' from secrets/bits-restricted-sign-key.enc.pem, make restricted-sign-key). The backend and bits-store mount its agent socket; it cannot reach the manifest signer (M8b). Copy to STORE_TOKEN_SIGNER_CONFIG_DIR as config.json (root-owned, read-only). 'cert' is a never-provisioned slot: the daemon needs a credential of some kind, the local sign route needs no TLS.
